notes.title: The Dream Of A Cockspur Demo Walkthrough
notes.content:
The Dream Of A Cockspur Demo Walkthrough.  

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------



The field is the world, and the good seed represents the people of the Kingdom. The weeds are the people who belong to the evil one.
(Matthew 13:38)



-----------------------------------------------------------------------------

Stranded on a desolate island with Earth's final researchers, you investigate a mysterious celestial body. The day before departure, the return boat is damaged, forcing an extended stay. Is someone playing tricks, or does the island want to kill all of you?

Note
The demo version is a brief showcase of the art style, mood, and basic story setting of the game. For those who prefer a complete story experience, it is suggested to wait for the full version (Releasing end of this year).
